title: Histogram Equalization
text: Enhance contrast of images using histogram equalization, 2 inputs, 1 output; {Target histogram} sets the type of desired, {Number of bins}, {Histogram source} sets the source of target histogram Specify via and {Histogram} sets the bin counts of target histogram ones. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Target histogram
params.values: Type of desired histogram Uniform (default) | User-defined

params.name: Number of bins
params.values: Number of bins of target histogram 64 (default) | integer greater than one

params.name: Histogram source
params.values: Source of target histogram Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Histogram
params.values: Bin counts of target histogram ones(1,64) (default) | vector of integers
